defects.title: After a different person continues a kept sale, the paired customer display stops following for the rest of that sale
defects.steps: A mid-cart with a paired display; Sign out everywhere on A; B signs in, Continue this sale; change the cart (a second kid)
defects.seen: Till: "Display connection: Another till is holding this station. A manager can take it over. The team can continue using this screen." and it falls back to the test-harness half; the paired display stays on A's last order (Kids 1, ฿1240) while the till shows Kids 2 (฿2130). Watched 207 s with a change every 30 s: never healed.
defects.where: apps/pos/src/lib/displaySession.ts useStationDisplay: the publisher (channel) outlives the person (the Till stays mounted on Continue, OperatorContext.continueKept), so it keeps A's leaseId; the box refuses B's renew/publish 403 STATION_NOT_PERMITTED (packages/box-agent/src/station-session.ts renew → heldBy, NOT_THE_HOLDER), and the catch at displaySession.ts:815 clears the lease only on STATION_STALE / STATION_NO_LEASE, so it retries A's lease for ever.
defects.healsAt: After B finishes the continued sale and presses Start New Sale, the next sale follows on the display again (12a-1: B's next cart on the display). So the display is wrong for the rest of the continued sale only — which includes its payment step (03e: the display still shows A's order and no "Please pay").
defects.alsoSeen: Point 9: after B continued A's rung-up sale and voided it with Cancel, the paired display still said "Please pay ฿1590 to our staff" for the voided sale while the till was fresh (09e). Point 4: the same "Another till is holding this station" after Continue on the offer that had locked (04e).

defects.title: Minor: right after a session end, the next person's fresh till cannot take the display for up to about a minute; the display keeps the old cart meanwhile
defects.steps: A mid-cart with a paired display; Sign out everywhere on A; B signs in, Discard it and start a new sale
defects.seen: For about 27 s after Discard (about 70 s after A's session ended) the till said "Display connection: Another till is using this station. A manager can take it over. The team can continue using this screen." and the paired display still showed A's discarded cart (2 Hours Play ฿1240); then it healed by itself ("Display connected").
defects.where: The ended session's display lease is not released at the end (it runs out on its 60 s TTL, packages/box-agent/src/station-session.ts STATION_LEASE_TTL_S); the new seat's claim is refused no_lease until then (apps/pos/src/lib/displaySession.ts claim back-off).
defects.alsoSeen: Point 6a: after A's session ended with only a number typed, B's fresh till showed the same "Another till is using this station" line and the paired display still showed the previous customer's typed number (+66 0898878014, a ZZ TEST number) under "What's your phone number?" (06c) until the old lease ran out.
defects.alsoSeen2: Point 6b: after B's session ended on a finished sale's success screen, A's fresh till showed "Another till is using this station" and the display kept B's "Thank you! ... Credit ฿350" (06f).

defects.title: The SCRUM-942 family line is not shown when the session ENDS with the family form open (it is shown on an ordinary lock)
defects.steps: Paired display; walk-in, Tourist, 1 Hour Play, 1 kid and no adult, Continue: the drop-off form opens on the display and the till mirrors it ("The customer is filling this in"); the family types a child name; Sign out everywhere on A (heartbeat sent at once)
defects.seen: The sign-in form shows only "The session of ZZ TEST Session A has ended. Sign in again to carry on. The sale in progress is kept on this till." — no "A family is filling in the drop-off form on the display." line, read 4 times over 12 s and, on a second try, 6 times over 3 s. The same till locked with the lock button in the same state shows the line ("A family is filling in the drop-off form on the display.", 10g).
defects.where: The line is drawn by LockScreen.tsx:286 from the lockedFamilyForm store, which Till.tsx:3967 (useLockedFamilyFormWatch) feeds with formOpen = consentMirror && !completed && !finishing. consentMirror (Till.tsx:3946) needs `consent` (needs displayOnline, Till.tsx:3645/3759) and !inlineDisplay (Till.tsx:3931, false once linkedDisplay has an error). After a session end the till's requests answer 401 (seen: POST /box/v1/station/:id/intents 401, GET /me/station/link 401, GET /box/v1/station/:id/status 401), so formOpen goes false and the watch sets the line to null. The lane's test (apps/pos/test/s878-lock-screen.test.ts:165) sets the store directly, so it never meets this.

hunt.what: Twelve-hour words (page clock only moved 12 h 1 min with Playwright setFixedTime; nothing changed on the platform): "The session of ZZ TEST Session A ended after twelve hours. Sign in again to carry on. The sale in progress is kept on this till."; the same cart came back (the trading day comes from the platform).

A reload at the session-ended sign-in form drops the line and the kept cart (memory only, known and listed in the build report as minor): the line said the sale was kept, after the reload there is no line and the next sign-in is a fresh till.

On every carried-on sign-in the station toast "<till> is yours / Printing and scanning run through Virtual box 1." comes back and covers the header and the Configure heading on the phone till for a few seconds.

While the till shows the session-ended sign-in form, the paired display keeps showing the customer the order (and a waiting QR) with nothing saying the till is waiting for staff; it is the customer's own order, so noted only.

"Checking the payment after unlock." was on screen only for a moment (seen by a page observer 0.9 s after the sign-in press, not caught in a picture); the waiting QR (same attempt, timer 18:52) was then shown again and the simulator's approval closed the sale once.
The sign-in form keeps the last number typed on it: after B's session ended over the offer, the phone box still held B's number for the next person.
